## Plugin reference

- Description: Umbrella for the reusable version-history primitive: the domain-agnostic versioning engine substrate (more sub-plugins to follow).
- Sub-plugins:
  - **`dialog`** — Reusable version-history UI: the <VersionHistoryDialog> dialog — the timeline as a live DataView with a Restore row action, the active version's preview injected via renderPreview, navigation owned…
  - **`engine`** — Registers the version id kind (ver) with the web id registry — the server barrel registers the same kind. Domain-agnostic versioning substrate: the entity_versions table, a defineHistorySource…
